docs.text: Features Overview The Jigsaw Puzzle application provides an interactive puzzle-solving experience with the following core features: Real-time Collaboration Multiple participants can solve a puzzle simultaneously. The application uses WebSockets to synchronize progress and broadcast updates. Drag-and-Drop Functionality Participants can drag puzzle pieces and drop them onto a grid, mimicking physical puzzle assembly. Feedback System The application checks the correctness of the puzzle in real time: - Displays a success message when the puzzle is correctly assembled. - Provides helpful feedback if the assembly is incorrect. Dynamic Progress Updates Puzzle states are synchronized across all participants, ensuring a seamless collaborative experience.

docs.text: Real-time Interaction The Jigsaw Puzzle application enables participants to collaborate in real time using WebSocket-based communication. Key elements include: Synchronization: Updates to the puzzle state are broadcast to all connected participants. Interaction: Actions such as moving puzzle pieces are reflected instantly across all clients. Collaboration: Participants can work together to solve puzzles, fostering teamwork. This ensures a responsive and engaging experience for all participants.

docs.text: Drag-and-Drop Functionality The drag-and-drop interface allows participants to move puzzle pieces interactively. Client Actions A piece is dragged, triggering visual feedback. The piece is dropped onto a grid cell, signaling its placement. The client validates the piece's position for correctness. Server Actions Receives placement updates from clients. Broadcasts the new state to all participants, ensuring synchronization.

docs.text: Workflow Overview The Jigsaw Puzzle application workflow is designed to facilitate seamless interactions between participants and the server. Workflow Stages Socket Connection and Channel Join: Participants establish WebSocket connections and join the puzzle channel. Drag-and-Drop: Puzzle pieces are moved interactively on the grid. Puzzle Completion: The application validates puzzle assembly and provides feedback. WebSocket Messaging: Updates are communicated in real time to ensure synchronization. Each stage plays a vital role in maintaining the application's functionality.

Server Actions Broadcasts puzzle completion status (success or failure) to all participants. Updates the state for future interactions.

docs.text: Socket Connection and Channel Join Client Actions Establishes a WebSocket connection to the server. Joins the puzzle:lobby channel for communication. Receives acknowledgment upon successful connection. Server Actions Manages incoming WebSocket connections. Binds clients to the appropriate channel.
